## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `53e4b8c79b543183ad3a373e62cb4507b73e5a9c`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/domains/devx.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/domains/server.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/domains/skills.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/domains/spec.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/domains/ui.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/untrusted-text.md, .claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md + scripts/pm/card-pick.mjs, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs, scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh
Security-touching: yes
Rule-change-verified: none

Inputs read: card #35235 (body and all 8 comments, the claim 7186593220, its two amendments and the os-dev report 7187342634 included), the PR body, the net diff against `main` (15 files, +32/−34, 5 renames), the tree at the head through `git grep` and `git show`, and the 49 check-runs on the head (26 success, 23 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending; `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` and `Check Changeset` all success). Nothing was built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

- No accept-set changes and no public surface changes. No published package, schema or `skills/**` file is in the diff. Right.
- The reader set of the five files is unchanged: every pointer that named one of them at `main` names the same file at the head. Right (see ④, old-path sweep).
- `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: ten map keys re-keyed (five in `CEILINGS`, five in `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES`). With the directory name normalised, each removed line equals one added line: no number moved, no row added or dropped, no logic line changed. Right.
- The ratchet's derived lane roster (`LANES_DIR`, `laneFilesOnDisk`, `laneRosterVerdict`) reads `references/lanes/` only, so it now holds 12 files, not 17. The five moved files keep their ceiling rows and table-row pins, and join the other reference files, which have rows and no tree-against-map check. The narrowing is declared in the PR body and the report. See N1.
- `scripts/pm/card-pick.mjs`: the `DUTIES_PHRASES` entry equals line 51 of `execution-duties.md` at the head character for character, so the pin and the pinned sentence moved together. `UNREAD_LEGS` and the header comment change the printed path only. Right.
- `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh`: one comment line. No command changes. Right.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: the diff publishes nothing. `Clause-②: no` on the PR body and on the claim agrees with the diff: no accept set widens, no public surface grows. `Check Changeset` is success on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions` in the report: empty. Nothing to answer.
- Deviation, `REF_B` left as `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md` in `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` (line 6050): accepted. The constant is used twice (lines 6059 and 6062), both times as an element of a path list handed to `governedTierFor`. That function (`check-governed-merges.mjs` line 1793) is register-keyed and pure: it matches path strings against the governed register and opens no file. `lanes/skills.md` and `domains/skills.md` fall under the same `.claude/skills/**` row, so both assertions hold the same way with either spelling, and with the file absent from the tree. The guard and its self-test stay correct. The report's stated reason (an edit "would make the PR Tier H by path") does not carry the decision, since this PR is governed either way; the PR body's reason (a string that is classified and never opened) does. See N2.
- Deviation, ceilings of the shrunk files not lowered: accepted. The 110 freed bytes stay as headroom; no ceiling and no pin is raised. Measured at the head: every changed file is at or under its ceiling (`untrusted-text.md` 3279 of 3280, `spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md` 26917 of 26922, `SKILL.md` 33345 of 33351 with its widest table row at 341 of 341).
- Out-of-scope finding, `.claude/hooks/session-start-fleet.sh`: confirmed as described. For `OS_FLEET_LANE` set to one of the five retired names the hook prints its "no file on this checkout" line and exits 0. None of the five files carried a `Seat post:` line at `main`, so no seat-post number is lost. See N3.
- Running seats: the tree at the head holds no sentence a session follows that still names one of the five old paths. A session that loaded the skill text before the merge and then reads a checkout after it will look for `references/lanes/spec.md` (the contract-surface leg) and find nothing; that is the ordinary cost of the rename and ends when the session re-reads the skill. Not read, because it is outside the inputs: seat posts and project instructions on GitHub or in the cloud repository that may spell an old path.
- `Security-touching: yes` is the fail-closed reading, set on the literal test. One changed hunk, in `untrusted-text.md`, sits in the sentence that says what to do when an untrusted text asks for a token or a CI change; the hunk changes only the pointer in it (`lanes/server.md` to `domains/server.md`) and joins a wrapped line. The pointer resolves: `domains/server.md` line 52 holds the disclosure sentence. The taught behaviour is unchanged. This record's template does not carry the line for these paths (no `hits` path is on the low-risk arm, and the renames keep the PR off that arm), so the line changes no landing verdict; the adopting seat decides whether a `security` label is owed, and on this reading none is.
- SQL push-down: not applicable, no code that reads data.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

Old-path sweep, whole tree at the head (`lanes/` followed by one of devx, server, skills, spec, ui): seven lines remain, none of them a live reader.
- `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` line 6050: the `REF_B` fixture (③).
- `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` lines 189 and 245: two comments that record what earlier changes did. Right to leave.
- `.claude/hooks/session-start-fleet.selftest.sh` lines 34, 35 and 127: the self-test's own fixture tree, which it builds itself. Right to leave; not named in the PR body's list of three.
- `packages/lint/CHANGELOG.md` line 10362: a released entry. Right to leave.
No workflow, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/agents/**`, docs or test file names an old path. No script other than the ratchet and the hook reads the `lanes/` directory by listing or by a computed name.

Per file:
- `SKILL.md`: four domain rows re-pointed; `详见` becomes `见` in two rows, which changes no instruction. All four targets exist. Rows for `security`, `l2-review`, `eval`, `director` and `repo:objectstack` still point into `lanes/`, where those files are.
- `area-lease.md`, `triage-duties.md`, `untrusted-text.md`, `execution-duties.md` (two lines), `spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md`: path only; the last two un-wrap a line and change no word. Each cited target holds what the sentence says it holds.
- `project-forms.md`: the dropped exception 「域参考除外」 had nothing left to except. The set of seat words is the same before and after: the file names under `lanes/` minus the five, which is now simply the file names under `lanes/`.
- `domains/devx.md`, `server.md`, `spec.md`, `ui.md`, `skills.md`: the dropped header clause said only that the file's fate waited for this step; no rule sits in it. `skills.md`: `director.md` and `qa.md` become `../lanes/director.md` and `../lanes/qa.md`, both of which exist. Sibling links between domain files (`spec.md` and `devx.md` from `server.md`, `spec.md` from `skills.md`) and the `../` links (`execution-duties.md`, `security-findings.md`, `readings-queue.md`, `contract-review.md`) resolve from the new directory.
- `references/lanes/` at the head: twelve files, each byte-identical to `main`.

`Rule-change-verified: none`, equal to the PR body's `Rule-change: none`: no changed hunk alters what an agent may do without the maintainer, what gets done or in what order, or what must go to him. The diff is a file move, pointers that follow it, and two wording trims.

Nits:
- N1 (nit) — the ratchet's tree-against-map check no longer covers the five domain files: a new file under `references/domains/`, or a deleted row for one of the five, is not red by construction. Extending the roster is a logic change outside this card's fence (strings and data only), so it belongs on a follow-up card; the report lists it as "noted, not filed".
- N2 (nit) — two self-test fixtures (`REF_B`, and the hook self-test's `lanes/skills.md` and `lanes/devx.md`) now name paths that no longer exist in the tree. Both are correct as tests. Accepted deviation.
- N3 (nit) — `.claude/hooks/session-start-fleet.sh` still describes a lane name as "the stem of references/lanes/" a file; true for the twelve seat files, and the five retired names now fall to its no-file line. Accepted as stated on the card.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：pm-dispatch 技能里 5 个按领域划分的参考文件，从 `references/lanes/` 搬到 `references/domains/`。所有指向它们的链接、`card-pick.mjs` 的钉住短句，以及行数棘轮的 10 个键都跟着改了路径，数字和规则一个都没动。
- 为什么：#35235（pm-dispatch 第 4c 步）。把「座位车道」和「领域参考」分开，`lanes/` 只留座位的岗位说明。
- 风险：只改智能体工具文档和三个脚本的路径。复核逐句核对过，没有哪条规则改了意思，全仓也没有还在读旧路径的地方。唯一的副作用：棘轮的「目录对照表」检查只看 `lanes/`，所以这 5 个文件以后新增或删除不会自动报红（它们的行数上限照旧）。这一点由跟进卡处理。
- 要你做什么：批准合并。契约复核 PASS 在评论 7188024721，Head-sha `53e4b8c79b543183ad3a373e62cb4507b73e5a9c`。

席位意见：ACCEPT。纯搬家，没有改语义。三条 nit 都不影响正确性。

2. **Premise**: every pointer that named one of the five files on `main` names the same file at the head.
   - The ratchet re-keys ten rows, with no number or logic line moved.
   - The `card-pick.mjs` pin equals `execution-duties.md` line 51.
   - Seven old-path lines remain, and none is a live reader: `REF_B`, two history comments, three hook self-test fixture lines, and one released CHANGELOG entry.
3. **Gates**: 26 success, 23 expected skips, 0 failed at `53e4b8c79b`. Mergeable clean.
4. **Accepted deviations** (contract nits):
   - The `REF_B` fixture is left on `lanes/skills.md`. It only feeds `governedTierFor`, which matches strings and opens no file.
   - N2: the hook self-test fixtures name the old paths.
   - N3: the `session-start-fleet.sh` comment.
5. **Out of scope and where it went**: N1. The ratchet's tree-against-map check reads `lanes/` only, so a new or deleted file under `domains/` is no longer red by construction. This is a logic change outside the card's fence. Area o5-P files a follow-up card under #35235, carrying N2 and N3 with it.
6. **Landing terms**: Tier H, whole PR. L2 at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`: PASS, comment 7188024721, same head, no open must-fix or should-fix. The record says `Security-touching: yes` (the `untrusted-text.md` pointer), so the `security` label goes on. It waits for the approver. After an APPROVED review, the seat or area lands it.
